constants.TOP_K_note: v3.1 uses full-decoder continuous loading (no TOP_K)

decision_rule: A submodule is a REAL program iff excess over Progenitor baseline > EXCESS_FLOOR AND abundance-matched permutation q < PERM_Q. Asymmetric modularity (erythroid more distributed than granulocyte) is SUPPORTED iff in >=3/5 seeds: ery_n_real>=2 AND ery_n_real>=gran_n_real AND ery excess-entropy > gran. Report the plain program-count finding regardless of verdict.
frozen_before: Phase 1 finalization final runs and all Phase 2 data inspection
loading_enrichment_definition: per (seed,feature,submodule): (sum |decoder| on submodule markers / total feature |decoder|) * (N_genes / K). 1.0 = null. submodule strength = mean of top-FEAT_TOP features.

gate2.strong_pass: >=8/24 TFs top-3 q<0.05 effect>0.5SD in >=2 seeds

phase2_causal_null.test: one-sided exact binomial vs 6.2%, expression-space AND embedding-space SAE features run through the identical pipeline (head-to-head)
